props.name: value
props.description: The change itself: 12.4 for +12.4%, -3 for −3. Sign carries the direction.

props.name: format
props.description: Percent adds a % and reads “percent”; number reads the figure as it is.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Most fraction digits shown. Trailing zeros are dropped.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit after a number delta, such as “pts” or “ms”. Read out as written.

props.name: inverse
props.description: Down is good for this metric — churn, latency, cost. Flips the colour, not the arrow.

props.name: tone
props.description: Overrides the colour worked out from the sign.

props.name: flatThreshold
props.description: Changes whose size is at or below this count as flat.

props.name: context
props.description: Comparison shown after the figure and read with it, such as “vs last week”.

props.name: showContext
props.description: Show the context text. When false it is still read out — for a strip that states the comparison once.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain coloured text, or a tinted pill.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the figure. Defaults to the reader’s.
